evidence.title: Right-Sizing LLM-Agent Decomposition in VAT Determination: A Pilot Controlled Sweep

summary: A controlled pilot demonstrated that right‑sizing the decomposition of large‑language‑model agents significantly boosts accuracy and efficiency in value‑added tax (VAT) determination. The findings suggest the technique can be generalized to other tax‑compliance and regulatory automation tasks.
title: Pilot Study Shows Optimized LLM-Agent Decomposition Improves VAT Determination
